A blank cell to experiment in. This page starts its own R session — re-create anything from earlier lessons you want to build on, for example the `students` data frame from Lesson 5 or the `scores` vector from Lesson 2.

```{webr-r}
# Try it yourself! For example:
students <- data.frame(
  name  = c("Ada", "Grace", "Rosalind"),
  score = c(92, 88, 95)
)
scores <- c(88, 92, 79, 95, 67)

mean(students$score)
boxplot(scores, main = "Scores", col = "#a855f7")
```
